__comment: Packet B1: Distortion `outputGain` bit-identity pin. This patch authors NO outputGain key, so the generator must emit the distortion block byte-for-byte as it did before the parameter existed — the makeup-gain multiply is elided entirely, not emitted as `* 1.0`. Sibling distortion_output_gain.json is the same patch WITH the param; the two goldens' distortion blocks differing by exactly the out_gain lines is the proof. Also the first golden coverage of Distortion at all (F-A06-11).
